amplitude.description: Cogging amplitude A_k [N·m] of harmonic k (EQ-MOT-08).

ConstantForm.description: Which motor constant the user entered (the others are derived, EQ-CONV-13).

speed_loop.description: Optional speed loop around the six-step drive.

sensorless.description: Use the flux observer instead of a sensor.

oneOf.description: Flat-top width per half period [rad or "120 deg"] (EQ-MOT-03).

flat_top.description: Flat-top width per half period [rad or "120 deg"], 0 … π (EQ-MOT-03).

oneOf.description: Harmonics n (odd) with amplitude b_n relative to the fundamental and phase φ_n.

terms.description: Harmonics in addition to the fundamental.

bypass.description: Use the true value instead of the sensor model.

noise.description: Noise standard deviation (in the sensor unit).

bypass.description: Use the true value instead of the sensor model.

noise.description: Noise standard deviation (in the sensor unit).

inverter_mode.description: Override the tier's inverter mode (averaged / switching).

tier.description: Model detail: ideal, standard (default) or detailed (EQ-NUM-07).

efficiency.description: Efficiency η (0 < η ≤ 1), the same both ways (EQ-MECH-03).

ratio.description: Ratio N = motor turns per output turn (N > 1 reduces speed).

bypass.description: Use the true value instead of the sensor model.

hysteresis.description: Switching hysteresis (fraction of the field amplitude).

noise.description: Noise standard deviation (in the sensor unit).

temperature.description: All thermal nodes start here (default: ambient).

i_eps.description: Current smoothing for the dead-time sign (EQ-INV-03, default 10 mA).

i_max.description: Maximum phase current of the stage.

v_max.description: Maximum bus voltage of the stage.

voltage_fraction.description: Usable fraction of the available voltage (0 … 1].

arm_mass.description: Mass of the arm itself (uniform rod).

distance.description: Distance of the point mass from the axis.

on_change.description: What a live mass change keeps: speed (default) or momentum (D-007).

bandwidth.description: Target bandwidth [rad/s] (gains derived, EQ-CTRL-03/04) or explicit gains.

connection.description: Winding connection (`star` or `delta`); the model always uses star-equivalent values (EQ-CONV-14).

entered_as.description: Which constant was entered; the others are derived and locked.

ke.description: Back-EMF constant (LL peak) [V·s/rad] — derived unless entered.

kt.description: Torque constant (per peak phase A) [N·m/A] — derived unless entered.

kv.description: Velocity constant (LL peak) [rpm/V] — derived unless entered.

l_d.description: d-axis inductance [H] (= l_q for non-salient motors).

lambda_m.description: Magnet flux linkage, peak per phase [Wb] — canonical constant (EQ-CONV-09…11).

air_gap.description: Mechanical air gap between stator and magnets.

magnet_arc.description: Magnet arc as a fraction of the pole pitch (0…1).

rotor_od.description: Rotor outer diameter (the can for an outrunner).

stack_length.description: Axial length of the stator stack.

name.description: Display name of the motor (e.g. "Generic 8108 outrunner").

size_class.description: Size class `DDHH` (stator diameter × stack height, mm), e.g. "8010".

topology.description: Rotor position: `inrunner` (rotor inside) or `outrunner` (rotating can outside).

cogging.description: Cogging harmonics: amplitude [N·m] and phase per harmonic of N_c (EQ-MOT-08).

electrical.description: Resistance, inductances and the motor constant.

geometry.description: Dimensions (optional; used by estimates and the 3D view).

magnetic.description: Back-EMF shape, cogging, iron loss, saturation.

c_h.description: Heat capacity of the housing / can [J/K].

c_s.description: Heat capacity of the stator iron [J/K].

t_ref.description: Reference temperature of R and λ (default 20 °C).

slots.description: Number of stator slots Q (e.g. 12 in "12N14P").

overrides.description: Dotted path inside the component → new value, e.g. `electrical.r_phase: 0.2 ohm`.

Raw.description: A raw value as written: a number (SI) or a quantity string.

l_inf.description: Incremental q inductance deep in saturation [H].

observer_gamma.description: Gain γ of the sensorless flux observer (EQ-CTRL-09).

oneOf.description: Computed from other parameters by a constraint rule (locked in the UI).

chemistry.description: Cell chemistry (sets the OCV curve meaning).

ocv_cell.description: Per-cell OCV table: (SoC, volts) pairs, ascending SoC.

r0_cell.description: Series resistance per cell (Thevenin R0, EQ-SUP-03).

level.description: Trip level (in the watched quantity's unit).
